verdict.rationale: The axis applies: recurring access certification is a core identity-governance capability for an IAM platform. However, the pack never documents scheduled access reviews, reviewer routing, or sign-off records. Lifecycle workflows (joiner/mover/leaver automation), entitlement-management assignment of external users, and an identityGovernance Graph namespace are adjacent governance features, not certification campaigns.

support.subject: As a security engineer, access gets re-justified on a schedule — certification campaigns route who-has-what to reviewers and produce audit-ready sign-off records
